name: Hand-Drawn Marker
summary: Marker scribbles on dotted paper for the problem, an eraser on the drop, and clean UI with one coral ring for the proof.
look: Warm dotted notebook paper, red marker rings and strike-throughs, an amber highlighter smear, Instrument Serif italic as handwriting, then crisp white UI with teal single-stroke ticks and a peach sticky note.

components.name: Dotted paper
components.role: warm off-white with a 30 px dot grid; the eraser leaves a dot-free band

components.name: Red marker ring
components.role: double overshooting ellipse around the one number that matters

components.name: Strike-through + loop arrow
components.role: marker lines over chores and an arrow that loops back to the start

components.name: Highlighter smear
components.role: amber at 40 %, ragged ends, under the active item

components.name: Sketch → real seam
components.role: pencil dashed wireframe that becomes crisp UI as a vertical seam passes

components.name: Sticky note + tape
components.role: peach note, 5° tilt, teal tape; carries the agent’s one-line suggestion

motion.name: Stroke draw
motion.how: SVG stroke-dashoffset 100 → 0 over 0.3–0.5 s, power1.inOut, with a 1–2 px jitter pass for hand feel

motion.name: Eraser wipe
motion.how: mask rect scaleX 0 → 1 in exactly one beat (0.5 s at 120 BPM), linear, landing on the drop

motion.name: Sticky slap
motion.how: rotate 12° → 5°, scale 1.1 → 1, back.out(2) 0.25 s on a downbeat, plus a 2-frame shadow squash

story: Hook: a handwritten chore list (open dashboard, refresh, export, ask in chat, check again) is struck out and looped under the question, with “38 tabs!!” circled. Reveal: an eraser wipes the page on the drop and “You ship. Pulse watches.” plus the Acme Pulse lockup is inked over pencil guides. Proof: a pencil wireframe becomes the Pulse panel; teal ticks for healthy metrics, a coral ring around Checkout conversion −18% with a note “since 09:42, deploy #2231!” and a sticky note “Roll back? your call.” CTA: clean lockup, one hand-drawn underline and Start free.
adapt: Scribble over your users’ current manual process in the hook, erase it on the drop, and let your real UI appear through a sketch→real seam; keep exactly one marker ring for the moment your product catches something.

references.note: Excalidraw’s hand-drawn diagram look (built on Rough.js)

fit.risk: Too many scribbles look childish; keep marks to the problem frames and numbers in clean type.
